blinding: Not strictly blind: original reports and proposed labels were seen during setup. Subsequent scoring used full JDs and query criteria without ranking scores. review-packet.json omits ranks, model names and labels for a future independent review.
metrics_scope: Only fully adjudicated queries enter this AI-review experiment; original query text, requests, as_of and jobs unchanged. Pending cases excluded rather than treated as negatives.
deduplication: Exact identical requests have identical labels. Template variants retained for historical paired comparison, not independent real-user samples.
